hero.title: BBS in Finland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Earn a comprehensive Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) in Finland, integrating core management principles, business economics, quantitative analysis, and corporate strategy. International students build strong business acumen and explore post-graduation residence permit options for employment under Finnish immigration regulations.

overview: A BBA in Finland is a popular option for students who want to build a career in international business, management, marketing, finance, sales or entrepreneurship. Finnish universities of applied sciences offer practical, career-oriented business education, with programmes that combine classroom learning, business projects, teamwork and industry experience.
Explore world-class Finnish research universities and universities of applied sciences (UAS) offering English-taught degrees, high innovation ranking, and generous scholarships.

universities.name: University of Helsinki
universities.desc: Finland's oldest and highest-ranked institution (founded 1640), globally recognized among the top 1% of research universities for sciences, medicine, and education.

universities.name: University of Oulu
universities.desc: An international science university pioneering 6G wireless technology, arctic innovation, sustainable energy, and multidisciplinary research.

universities.name: Tampere University
universities.desc: One of Finland's most multidisciplinary universities, known for cutting-edge technology, social sciences, photonics, and signal processing.
